theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cttp_blowup_limit_translation_invariant
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C C' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (p : Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), IsIntegerMultiplicity C → IsConeCurrent C → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → MassMeasuresConverge (fun j => blowUp C p (lams j) (hlams j).ne') C' → ∀ R' : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R'.Represents C' → ∀ v ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {p}, ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R'.measure ((fun x => x + v) ⁻¹' A) = R'.measure A
